title.it: Incontro alla Casa Bianca tra Trump e l’inviato russo Kirill Dmitriev
title.en: White House meeting between Trump and Russian envoy Kirill Dmitriev

description.it: Il 5 novembre Associated Press ha riferito di un incontro alla Casa Bianca tra Donald Trump e Kirill Dmitriev, in parallelo a consultazioni con altri rappresentanti ucraini e occidentali. È un contatto diplomatico pubblico riportato dalla stampa, non prova di coordinamento clandestino.
description.en: On 5 November the Associated Press reported a White House meeting between Donald Trump and Kirill Dmitriev, in parallel with consultations with other Ukrainian and Western representatives. It is a public diplomatic contact reported by the press, not proof of covert coordination.

notes: Fonte_09 OEM26-019, update type NEW_EVENT. Evidence level of the main link per Fonte_09: E3 reporting.
Themes, places and the single evidence_level (the lower of any pair given) were assigned editorially from the Fonte_09 text.
Diplomatic contact only; no relationship recorded.
